correctness.rationale: The support inequalities for each of three outer unit normals make fixed complex multiplier z=(s,t) translation fibers nonempty precisely when g_T(z)=sum(ell_j/2A)h_(L_z T)(n_j)≤1, and then each fiber is translated (1−g)T of area A(1−g)^2. Mixed-area positivity g≥|z| yields compact footprint F and homogeneous Minkowski gauge. A feasible map induces a nonnegative column-stochastic 3×3 barycentric matrix with eigenvalues 1,s+it,s−it; tr B≥0 gives s≥−1/2, and tr(B²)≥(tr B)^2/3 gives (1−s)^2≥3t². Thus F lies in the cube-root-of-unity triangle E. For an equilateral T, three rotation multipliers are realized; conversely a full-area F forces a 120-degree equal-area self-rotation, so T equilateral. Integrate gauge sublevel areas r² area(F): vol4=A area(F)/6; projected radius has density 12r(1−r)^2 (Beta 2,3), CDF 6r²−8r³+3r⁴. Independent algebra independently checked the tr(B²) expansion, Beta density normalization/moments and equilateral area 3sqrt3/4. Orientation-preserving similitudes only, ordinary coordinate volume.
